reality_delta: The main AI produced configuration artifacts (scan account, amended blueprint) and aligned git state, but has not demonstrated that prerequisite validation commands pass, has not initiated the actual scan, and asks Prism to validate claims about file contents without including those contents in the evidence.
main_concern: Preparation was substituted for execution: the scan has not been started, prerequisite checks are asserted but not evidenced, and Cap granted itself final arbitration authority that conflicts with the constraint against blind veto.
top_risks: Prerequisite checks (prism-shard check, phase2-blueprint check) may fail; the launch claim is built on unverified readiness.

Cap's final arbitration authority over Prism feedback creates a structural conflict-of-interest, enabling self-deception loops and undermining the constraint that Cap must resolve disagreements rather than veto them.
The seven-shard coverage and no-promote boundaries are summarized but not evidenced; known pre-revival issues may exist in undocumented gaps.
missing_evidence: Command output proving runtime/bin/redcap prism-shard check passes.
Command output proving runtime/bin/redcap phase2-blueprint check passes.
Actual contents of the scan account and blueprint files (or a trusted completeness proof) to verify the seven-shard coverage and no-promote boundary claims.
minimum_fix: Execute both prerequisite checks and include their passing output in evidence; replace Cap's unilateral final arbitration with an escalation rule to Norven when bounded Prism discussion fails to reach consensus; include either the full scan account contents or a cryptographic manifest proving the seven shards exactly cover all known pre-revival issues.

anti_loop_signal.reason: The executor (Cap) authored both the scan constraints and its own arbitration rules, then asked external reviewers to validate self-authored boundaries—a setup structurally prone to confirmation bias.

user_intent_alignment: Low-Medium. Norven asked Cap to confirm the checkpoint and then start the scan. The main AI confirmed the checkpoint and produced launch-configuration documents, but did not actually start the scan, effectively rewriting execution into configuration.
